svg.title: Switching the observability source via the uses line in the entry workflow

desc.style: fill:rgb(0, 0, 0);stroke:none;color:rgb(0, 0, 0);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto

svg.desc: The entry workflow uses a reusable workflow per source. New Relic is active, Sentry is the migration target. Each source owns its fetch, config, and parse-and-upload because query styles and response formats differ; both reusable workflows call the same shared Slack notification file. Switching swaps the uses line.
